description: Refusal-as-form: one static key (F minor), one slow swell, no drop, no mid-track climax. The level keeps getting pulled out from under the rise (dropouts at ~2:20, ~2:55, ~3:35, ~5:00), and the loudest moment comes at 94% of the runtime, then darkens and steps back. The signal is here, then it isn't.
name: offline

sections.name: Intro (fade-in)
sections.notes: Fade in from near-silence: first window -24.4dB RMS, centroid 900Hz. A low wash, not a statement. Let it take a full minute to arrive.

sections.name: Slow climb
sections.notes: Gradual rise, RMS -14.7 to -14.4 per 30s. Still brighter than the peaks will be. No sudden moves.

sections.name: First peak
sections.notes: Loudest block until the finale (-10.5dB at 2:00, -10.4 at 2:30). Loud = dark: centroid drops to ~2100Hz. A dropout inside the peak (-16.3 at 2:20) - the signal cuts even here.

sections.name: Valley
sections.notes: The brightest timbre in the track lives in the quietest part (centroid up to 3651Hz at 2:55, dips to -17.0dB). Let the emptiness be bright - do not fill it.

sections.name: Rebuild
sections.notes: Slow rise, -14.5 to -13.1 per 30s, no sudden moves. One more dropout (-17.0 at 3:35) early in the rebuild to reset the climb.

sections.name: Finale surge
sections.notes: The track's actual peak, at the very end: loudest window -8.9dB at 5:15. Then darken hard (centroid 1283Hz at 5:25) and step back to -12.2dB. A door closing, not a fade - no comedown after the peak.
